about: 2-fer rule changes and the parks each one touches (Brandon Nov 9 2026, 4:37-4:42 PM CST: 'only redo the parts that changed'; KISS). A saved pair result is reused unless one of its two parks changed (outline, record ids, POTA pin / name, line) or a change below covers one of the parks. Add one entry per rule change: id (never reuse an id), when, why, and scope = {states: ['US-KY', 'CA-ON', ...], kinds: [words in the POTA park type, e.g. 'Wild and Scenic River'], flags: ['bad-pin', 'line']} or 'all' (every pair: emergency only). Emergency switch without an entry: KPC_FERS_FULL=1. The areas workflow also does ONE full area per run, round-robin (.github/fers-areas.json full_cycle_days).

changes.why: a park with a bad POTA pin (pin00 / 0,0) is tested by its saved record ids, never around its pin (run 42649544758)
